invented_facts: Only one Vantage Pro 16 unit was tested; the paper says three units of each configuration were tested.
Both Aurora 14 configurations achieved a median of 38 tokens per second on the 8B model; the paper reports that figure only for the base configuration.
notes: The output preserves several important results and caveats, including Vantage’s image-generation advantage, but omits test conditions such as the 22 °C environment, AC power, default performance mode, and 2,000-token prompt. It also uses six bullets instead of the requested three key messages and exceeds the 250-word limit.
